Je me permets de relancer l'annonce ci-dessous car nous avons décidé d'étendre la date limite pour les candidatures à la fin de cette semaine (*_24 avril_*). Sujet disponible ici: partage.laas.fr/index.php/s/RGLoaPyikbDmcoZ

Cordialement,

Thierry Vidal, PhD in Artificial Intelligence

Research Fellow - RIS (Robotics and InteractionS) team - LAAS-CNRS, Toulouse email:thierry.vidal@laas.fr

Associate Professor (Maitre de Conferences) - Technical University of Tarbes (UTTOP) email:thierry.vidal@uttop.fr My colleague Arthur BIT-MONNOT and I offer a PhD position in our team RIS at LAAS-CNRS in Toulouse (www.laas.fr/en/teams/ris), within the area of symbolic AI task planning, starting in September/October 2026. The title is */A-PEACH : Autonomous Planning and Execution Aligned with Contingencies from Humans/* Please find attached the detailed thesis proposal, in French and in English. Feel free to distribute to any student who might be interested. In case you would like to apply, please send *us* (abitmonnot@laas.fr, thierry.vidal@laas.fr), *before April the 16th*:
- complete CV
- details about your Master internship
- complete transcript of records, especially at Master level
- a letter of motivation
- letters of recommendation if any
(Fluency in French is not mandatory, but good writing and oral skills in English are.)
